# OligoTox Models Directory

## Structure

```
models/
├── baseline/              # Original Random Forest models (19 endpoints)
├── improved/              # XGBoost + SMOTE models (19 endpoints)
│   ├── *_xgboost.pkl     # Trained XGBoost classifiers
│   └── training_results.json  # Performance metrics
└── README.md
```

## Model Files

**Note:** Trained model files (`.pkl`) are not included in this repository due to size constraints. Models can be regenerated by running:

```bash
python src/models/train_improved_models.py
```

## Model Performance

See `models/improved/training_results.json` for detailed metrics including:
- AUROC (Area Under ROC Curve)
- Precision, Recall, F1-score
- Feature importance rankings
- Training configuration
